name: BMC Minerals Limited
summary: BMC Minerals Limited acquires, explores and evaluates mineral properties in Canada, looking for silver, zinc, copper, lead, gold and other metals. Its main asset is the Kudz Ze Kayah project in Yukon. Incorporated in 2014 and formerly BMC Minerals (No.1) Ltd., it is based in Vancouver and is a subsidiary of Bmc (Uk) No 1 Limited.
